verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's Experimentation docs state that A/B test results are read through a built-in Bayesian statistics engine, fed by events collected into a managed data warehouse. The engine is only named in a single line, with no methodology detail and no variance-reduction options, so trust in its rigor is not established. Missing for 10: variance-reduction options (e.g. CUPED), in-depth documentation of the statistical methodology (priors, decision thresholds, metrics), independent or hands-on corroboration of result quality.
